_about: Walking graph for indoor turn-by-turn steps. Coordinates use the same local metres as rooms.json. l is the floor level; b is the building (SP Salt Palace, HY Hyatt). Edge texts are the instruction to show when walking a->b (textAB) or b->a (textBA).

origin.formula: x = (lng - lon0) * metersPerDegLon; y = (lat - lat0) * metersPerDegLat. x is east, y is north, true north. Flat-earth is fine at this scale (< 1 km).

magneticDeclination: About 10 degrees east at Salt Lake City. Compute it at runtime with android.hardware.GeomagneticField and add it to the magnetic heading to get true heading.

routing.algorithm: Dijkstra over nodes/edges. Edge cost = horizontal distance in metres + 40 per level changed.
routing.roomAttach: A room is reached from rooms.json[room].attachNode; its last step is rooms.json[room].finalStep. Starting from a room: begin at that room's attachNode.
routing.startText: From an entrance: 'Start at the {entrance.name}.' From a room: 'Start at {room name}, then step out to the {node.name}.'; if the room's finalStep begins with 'You’re there', say 'Start in the {node.name}.' instead.

lowerConcourseMerge.rule: Consecutive same-level legs between these nodes collapse into one step. Heading north: "Walk north up the Lower Concourse to {where}. Hall DE and the showcase are on your left, the Grand Ballroom on your right." Heading south: "Walk south down the Lower Concourse to {where}. The Grand Ballroom is on your left, Hall DE and the showcase on your right."

where.S200: the 200 South entrance and badge pick-up
where.NF: the North Foyer at the far end

routing.distanceSuffix: Append " About N m." (rounded to 10) to same-level steps of 40 m or more.
routing.summary: Total = polyline length through start, nodes and room. Minutes = max(1, round(total*1.15/75 + |levels changed|*0.6)). Show "About {round10(total)} m · {min} min · up/down N level(s)".
routing.stepKinds: start, walk, up, down, end; up/down when the leg changes level.

UCN.name: north end of the Upper Concourse

edges.textAB: Walk north up the Lower Concourse, away from the Hyatt connector.
edges.textBA: Walk south down the Lower Concourse to the 200 South entrance and badge pick-up.

edges.textAB: Keep going north. Hall DE is on your left, the Grand Ballroom on your right.
edges.textBA: Keep going south. The Grand Ballroom is on your left, Hall DE on your right.

edges.textAB: Keep going north to the North Foyer, where the Grand Ballroom ends.
edges.textBA: Walk south out of the North Foyer into the Lower Concourse.

edges.textAB: Take the North Foyer escalator up to Level 2. You arrive on the Upper Concourse.
edges.textBA: Take the escalator down to the North Foyer on Level 1.

edges.textAB: Turn left through the Solutions Showcase main entrance into Halls A–C.
edges.textBA: Leave Halls A–C through the main entrance onto the Lower Concourse.

edges.textAB: Walk to the far (north) end of Halls A–C, where the showcase turns left into Hall 1, the Alpine Overlook.
edges.textBA: Walk from Hall 1 into Halls A–C and head for the showcase main entrance on the east side.

edges.textAB: Keep heading west through Halls 2, 3 and 4 to Hall 5 at the far end.
edges.textBA: Head east back through Halls 4, 3 and 2 to Hall 1.

edges.textAB: Head to the north side of Hall 1, by the Secondary Entrance and Rooms 155.
edges.textBA: From the Secondary Entrance, walk into Hall 1, the Alpine Overlook.

edges.textAB: Take the escalator by Rooms 155 up to Level 2. You arrive on the Upper Mezzanine.
edges.textBA: Take the escalator by Rooms 255 down to Level 1, by the Secondary Entrance.

edges.textAB: Walk north along the Upper Concourse, past Rooms 250 and 251.
edges.textBA: Walk south along the Upper Concourse, past Rooms 251 and 250.

edges.textAB: At the end of the concourse, follow the corridor that bends left.
edges.textBA: Follow the corridor back to the Upper Concourse.

edges.textAB: Stay on the corridor past Room 254 until it opens onto the Upper Mezzanine.
edges.textBA: Leave the Upper Mezzanine at its east end and follow the corridor past Room 254.

edges.textAB: You come in on Level 2 at East Registration (coat check). Walk straight in to the Upper Concourse.
edges.textBA: Walk east past East Registration to the West Temple exit.

edges.textAB: Go through the Hyatt connector beside badge pick-up into the Hyatt lobby.
edges.textBA: Take the connector from the Hyatt lobby into the Salt Palace. You come out at badge pick-up, at the south end of the Lower Concourse.

edges.textAB: Take the Hyatt escalator up to Level 2.
edges.textBA: Take the Hyatt escalator down to the lobby.

edges.textAB: Take a Hyatt elevator up to Level 3.
edges.textBA: Take a Hyatt elevator down to the lobby.

edges.textAB: Take the escalator up two more levels to Level 4. You arrive in the Regency Foyer.
edges.textBA: Take the escalator down to Level 2.

edges.textAB: Take the Hyatt escalators or an elevator up to Level 4. You arrive in the Regency Foyer.
edges.textBA: Take the escalators or an elevator down to the Hyatt lobby.

edges.textAB: Take a Hyatt elevator up one level to Level 5.
edges.textBA: Take a Hyatt elevator down to Level 4.
